events.title: Elvis Presley: 49 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the world lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away at Graceland on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years ago today, we said goodbye to a legend. Elvis Presley's music still moves us. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since Las Vegas Shooting
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, passing away six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today, 30 years since the tragic shooting in Las Vegas. His influence on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Hendrix's Guitar Genius
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the music world lost a true innovator. Jimi Hendrix's guitar work continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road: 57 Years On
events.blurb: On this day, 57 years ago in 1969, The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and even more iconic tracks. What's your pick from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today, The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, born September 7, 1951, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are truly timeless. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher, born September 21, 1972, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine': 51 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem of peace, 'Imagine', was released as a single in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years Since Launch
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and what's their best film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, born October 9, 1940, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, born October 27, 1939, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album": 58 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the "White Album".

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. So diverse, so experimental. What's the hidden gem track you always go back to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul": 61 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly pushed boundaries. What impact did it have on you?
